trial.evidence: If you like Duolingo, try Super Duolingo for 14 days free!

ourRead: Every course is free, and an energy meter sells Super. Lesson screens show it falling 25, 24, 23, 22; Super’s perks include Unlimited Energy.
Super starts with 14 days free. Monthly Streak Repair ties it to the streak counter, so a missed day becomes a reason to pay.
6 Super listings run from $9.99 to $119.99. Gems add a second ladder: 1,200 for $4.99 up to 6,500 for $19.99, which gives 35% more gems per dollar.

improvements.title: Name each Super listing by its length
improvements.detail: The App Store shows 6 items named Super Duolingo, from $9.99 to $119.99. Add the length to each name, like “Super Duolingo, 1 year”, so shoppers can compare prices before install.
improvements.rule: Fix 3 things to stop a design from looking cheap: low contrast, a broken layout, and copy that does not convert.

improvements.title: Show energy in grey until it runs low
improvements.detail: Lesson screens put a pink energy meter next to the progress bar, so 2 colors compete above every question. Draw energy in grey #4B4B4B and turn it pink under 5, when Unlimited Energy starts to matter.
improvements.rule: One accent per screen. Directing attention means one place to look.

improvements.title: Darken the caption fills to pass 3:1
improvements.detail: 7 of 8 captions put white text on bright fills at 2.1 to 2.5:1. Fill each with the darker shade of its bottom edge, like #CE6603 under the orange, which reads at 3.8:1.
improvements.rule: Text contrast: at least 4.5:1 for body text, 3:1 for text 24 px and larger.

stylePrompt: Build a paywall in Duolingo’s style. Top to bottom: a mascot, a lowercase 2-line headline, 3 perks with icons, the plans, one full-width button. Type: Fredoka 600 for headlines, M PLUS Rounded 1c for body, dark grey #4B4B4B text. Colors: white #FFFFFF (60) for the screen, owl green #57CC02 (30) for the mascot and perk icons, streak orange #FF9600 (10) for the button. Cards and buttons: 12 px corners, 2 px border, 6 px darker bottom edge. Plans: one tier in rows with length and price; preselect yearly and show its per-month price. Put the 14-day trial on the button. Use my brand colors in the same 60/30/10 roles.
